title: Sequence and Grid DP
summary: Use one or two position indexes as state when the future problem is determined by where you are in one or two sequences or a dependency grid.
recognition_signals: the problem compares or transforms sequences
a state naturally uses one index per sequence or grid dimension
neighboring states represent insert, delete, replace, match, or extend decisions
core_rules: State indexes must preserve every position that changes future options.
Fill or memoize states in an order that satisfies the recurrence dependencies.
structural_steps: choose prefix or suffix index semantics
define empty-sequence or boundary base cases
write transitions from neighboring index states

common_confusions.distinction: This is a specialized DP shape where state is dominated by sequence or grid positions; the general DP family also covers resource, subset, and other state dimensions.
